_mo_ta: Backtest chien luoc dai han, 4 pha luoi lay mau thang, 52 thang, 112 ma HOSE, da tru phi 0,4%/vong quay. Chay 26/08/2026.

_pham_vi.A: thu hang tren TOAN RO (ban backtest cu 17/08/2026)
_pham_vi.B1: thu hang trong RO DA QUA BO LOC (Triet_ly_dau_tu_FF5); ma dang giu roi khoi bo loc van duoc chen diem vao bang xep hang
_pham_vi.B2: nhu B1 nhung ma dang giu roi khoi bo loc = hong quy tac 3 -> ban ngay
_pham_vi.tat_qt3: B1 nhung tat han quy tac thoat so 3 (hyst = 1,00)

_doi_chung: Pha 1 (ket thuc 2026-08-17) tai tao ban 17/08: A = 14,07% vs 13,89% cong bo, sut giam -21,4% vs -21,3%, t = 0,81 vs 0,87. Harness duoc xac nhan la trung thuc.
_ket_luan: 1. Con so 13,89% cong bo la MOT trong bon rut tham cua pha luoi, va la rut tham cao thu hai. Trung binh 4 pha cua cung phuong phap A la 12,09%, bien do 9,38-14,54%.
2. Pham vi B (theo ban chot) vuot index trung binh chi +0,72 diem phan tram/nam, t = 0,04-0,24 o ca 4 pha. Khong phan biet duoc voi 0.
3. Pham vi A vuot index o CA 4/4 pha (+1,67 den +5,98) va vuot B1 o ca 4/4 pha. Nhung 4 pha dung chung phan lon du lieu nen khong phai 4 quan sat doc lap.
4. Sut giam: B1 sau hon A o CA 4/4 pha (-29,5% so voi -23,2% trung binh). Day la phat bieu vung nhat trong bo so nay.

5. Tat han quy tac thoat 3: chenh so voi B1 la +2,44 / -2,71 / -2,52 / +3,06 diem pt theo tung pha -> trung binh +0,07. Tac dong cua quy tac 3 la NHIEU, khong phai tin hieu. Ket luan 'tat quy tac 3 tot hon' rut ra tu rieng pha 0 la SAI.

thamso_4pha._mo_ta: Do lai cac tham so THIET KE dang chay, pham vi B1 (ban chot), 4 pha luoi.

phan_bo.ghi_chu: 1/ATR cho sut giam nho hon o CA 4/4 pha (chenh TB 1,5 diem pt); loi nhuan ngang nhau.

chu_ky_ra_soat.ghi_chu: Hang quy TOT HON hang thang o 3/4 pha va TB +2,6 diem pt, sut giam nong hon 5,3 diem pt. NGUOC voi phat bieu 'ra soat hang quy lam tut 13,89% -> 7,06%' trong ban cu.

_ket_luan_them: 6. So o: TB 4 pha cho 5 o = 10,66%, 6 o = 10,50%, 10 o = 9,05%, 15 o = 8,05%. Ban cu do duoc dieu NGUOC LAI (10 o tot nhat, 5 o te nhat). N=5 tot hon N=10 o CA 4/4 pha. Co the co co che that: voi ro da loc, top 40% ~ 12 ma, nen N cang lon thi cang nhieu vi the nam sat nguong va bi quy tac 3 xoay vong.
7. Chu ky ra soat: hang quy TOT HON hang thang (TB 11,67% vs 9,05%, sut giam -24,1% vs -29,5%). Phat bieu 'toc do THOAT quan trong hon toc do vao' KHONG con duoc du lieu ung ho.
8. Phan bo 1/ATR: la lua chon thiet ke DUY NHAT song sot. Sut giam nho hon can bang deu o ca 4/4 pha, loi nhuan ngang nhau — dung nhu ly do da ghi ('chon vi rui ro, khong vi loi nhuan').
